annotation.authors_or_issuer: Đoàn đại biểu Quốc hội và Hội đồng nhân dân tỉnh Đắk Lắk
key_provisions_or_claims: Conference held 11-12 December 2024 in Da Nang on AI and refining AI policy and law.
Topics included EU AI policy strategy 2024-2030 and a legal framework for AI in Vietnam.
Sessions also covered AI opportunities and risks and AI's effects on labour and employment.
Aims to build a conceptual and legal foundation for managing AI effectively.
annotation.summary_en: Provincial National Assembly delegation news item on a conference in Da Nang (11-12 December 2024) about AI and improving AI policy and law in Vietnam. Topics include AI overview, EU AI strategy, Vietnam's legal framework, AI risks and opportunities, and AI's effects on labour. No robotics content.
